liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Not Fade Away is tucked between two halves of St. Stephen in the second-set run; Not Fade Away appears inside St. Stephen, within a long second-set sequence ending in Stella Blue [8][10]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Let It Grow, St. Stephen and The Other One stand out as sparkling in a nearly continuous second set [12]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 other source): Wharf Rat leads into a space jam and Drums before The Other One [1]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): The slow, funky lead-in to St. Stephen left a lasting impression on the reviewer [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is called exceptional, carrying many different emotions [15]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): The show opens with Half-Step and the intensity never lets up [15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet Begonias is one of the reviewer's favorites, along with Let It Grow and The Other One [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Pioneer Hi-Fidelity**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **3M Magnetic: Scotch Cassettes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Pioneer Hi-Fidelity**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

- **3M Magnetic: Scotch Cassettes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Pioneer Hi-Fidelity**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-07-18.pre-fm.kbfh.berger.107832.flac16** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 35 songs; 161 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1976-07-18.150982.pre-fm.miller.flying-m-.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: AC leakage tones were present at several frequencies; several small dropouts were filled in, some larger ones left alone [3]
- **gd1976-07-18.150187.pre-fm.miller.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: There is a line buzz, but it quiets down and doesn't interfere with the music [4]
- **gd1976-07-18.150770.remastered.miller.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd76-07-18.sbd.ferguson.244.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 192 min; rated 4.8/5 by 70 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard recording good, with smooth playing; The digital version sounds clear and crisp, much cleaner than the reviewer's old cassette; This copy is far cleaner than the reviewer's earlier cassette, which was spliced and hissy [8][11][16]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: KBFH [1]
- Reviewer notes seeing the band in theaters after a year and a half away must have been great; some tempos drag [16]
- Reviewer says no other 1976 show beats it, though 1977 shows are stronger overall [12]
- The night before is also very good, but this show should be heard first [12]
- Reviewer calls it arguably the best of 1976 and among the best of the 1970s [15]
- Reviewer says no 1976 show was better, even though 1976 isn't their favorite year [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-07-18.pre-fm.kbfh.berger.107832.flac16**: transferred by Rob Berger; source: Pre FM 7" 1/2 track reel @ 7.5 ips, no nr (Michael Schuncke's reels) [1]. Also: The tapes are reels that DIR Broadcasting distributed to radio stations for broadcast [1]
- **gd1976-07-18.150982.pre-fm.miller.flying-m-.flac1644**: source: This is a Flying -M- remaster reducing the buzz and hum with iZotope RX8 advanced [3]. Also: Flying-M remastered this tape in October 2020 using iZotope RX8 to reduce buzz and hum [3]
- **gd1976-07-18.150187.pre-fm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 21, 2020; source: (KSAN) Pre-FM > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [4]
- **gd1976-07-18.150770.remastered.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 27, 2020; source: (KSAN) Pre-FM > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [5]. Also: This is a remastered version of an earlier Miller transfer, fixing its previous issues [5]
- **gd76-07-18.sbd.ferguson.244.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: Reviewer has known the show for years from the KSAN-FM broadcast aired the night of the concert; Reviewer first heard the show on a decent cassette of the KSAN broadcast in the late 1970s [9][11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Elegant Themes: [The work of his day - The Deadhead Cyclist](https://www.deadheadcyclist.com/2022/10/10/the-work-of-his-day/) [21]
- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [Orpheum Theatre, San Francisco, CA 1192 Market Street, San Francisco, CA: Summer 1976 (plus Live FM Broadcasts Part X)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2016/04/orpheum-theatre-san-francisco-ca-1192.html) [22]
